quest.title: Gold Devouring and Mora Gathering
quest.description: The day for Hatim to conduct some futures trading has arrived. What will he get from this trade?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Traveler! Ah, I mean, wondrous child of fortune and luck! You're here!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I ate the "Golden Dish" you prepared the last time and made a killing on the Exchange!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I came here today to check and sure enough, I have made great gains on all the futures I bought!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Come, let's go to Lambad's Tavern, and you can order whatever you want. It'll be my treat! I must thank you, after all.

talks.objective: Talk to Hatim at Lambad's Tavern

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: This is all thanks to your help, so please, order whatever you'd like to eat today! Haha!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like you really did make a lot of Mora!

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: It is a good sum by a normal person's measure, but compared to the assets that I, Hatim, possess, it is but a mere ripple.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: After all, I am also privy to knowledge obtained from decades of experience as an old hand. If you are interested in futures, I can share some of my personal experiences with you, in fact.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: We agreed the last time that you shall gain additional benefits, so please, ask me anything.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh. Y'know, this additional benefit doesn't feel all that different from not having any!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We don't play with futures after all...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Oh, nonsense! You shall have a share of the Mora too, of course. But compared to that, my advice is what is truly of value!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Then Paimon has a question... Will there really be slime futures?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: N—Not that Paimon wants to profit, of course! Just asking...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Only commodities in circulation can become futures, so if there is as much Slime Condensate as flour and milk on the market, then it's possible for tradable Slime Condensate futures to be created.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: But I've mentioned this before. If you want to trade in Slime Condensate futures, I'm afraid that all Slimes in the wild will go extinct.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Plus, institutions or individuals who specialize in raising slimes may arise, and they may continuously produce large quantities of Slime Condensate.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: When that time comes, the price of Slime Condensate might also go up...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What!? It's just buying some Slime Condensate, how can things get so complicated...?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #P—Paimon'll just stick to getting {NICKNAME} to beat those Slimes up...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: What about you, Child of Fortune? Do you have any questions?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How did you come up with the idea of "Golden Dish"?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Ha! You really are a Child of Fortune. Straight to asking about the key to wealth.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I can't really say that I "came up with" it, but I can say that I learned about these "Golden Dishes" during my long career in futures trading.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: The futures trading market is treacherous... But as long as I have my "Golden Dishes," piloting this investment ship shall be a cinch!

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Ah, enough of that! Come, eat, eat! Eat up! I'll be asking for your help more often in the future.

response.speaker: Hatim
response.text: Here! Try this Shawarma Wrap. It's Sumeru's special dish. You really must try it, hahaha...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You enjoy the delicious food with Hatim...

choices.text: Isn't this just what they call "peace of mind"...?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I went to the "Wealth Spot" and even ate the "Golden Dish"...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: But the result is this drop...! This makes no sense! How is this market making any sense? Where's the fairness!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hatim, we've been looking for you for a long time. Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Ah, it's you guys... I... I'm fine. I'm great... Look. I'm not missing an arm or a leg or anything.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: I just lost my deposit... Ahem...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: S—Sorry...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: No! This is not your fault. Don't take it to heart.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Of course, it's certainly not my fault either. What's truly to blame is this market for being bad.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: It makes no sense! It doesn't follow rules! It just goes down like that, and goes up like... like... Well, it didn't go up...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Really, argh... I really...

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Never mind, I simply cannot believe it... I cannot believe that I, Hatim the exceptionally rich from Kalimi, still cannot conquer futures trading!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Didn't you lose everything...?

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Hmph, it doesn't matter. I still have plenty of backup funds.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Even if I don't have any Mora on hand, I still have working capital and assets elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Hatim
dialogues.text: Just you wait, Kalimi Exchange! I, Hatim, shall be back!
